   - Designed a stunning cyberpunk/neon theme with glowing gradients, canvas background grids, and smooth parallax stars.

   - Added responsive control prompts for Keyboard (`Space`, `Up Arrow`) and Touch/Mouse Clicks.

   - Added multiple obstacle types (ground spikes, tall blocks, and floating hazards) with progressive speed scaling.
